text: The Patriots' week took a significant hit when starting right guard Mike Onwenu suffered a broken right ankle in last week's dominant 20-3 victory over the Steelers, forcing the team to place him on injured reserve and sign punter Mitch Wishnowsky to the active roster while adding tight end Tanner Conner to the practice squad. While the defensive unit continues to impress—particularly with their suffocating man coverage that stymied Pittsburgh—the offense, including young QB Drake Maye, has yet to find the rhythmic consistency that characterized last season's Super Bowl run, though TreVeyon Henderson did punch in a rushing touchdown in the win. The Patriots now head to Jacksonville to face the Jaguars on Sunday at 1 PM ET, a matchup that will test whether the team can maintain its defensive dominance while Maye continues his adjustment to the NFL pace and decision-making demands. In lighter news, Patriots legend Adam Vinatieri etched himself into sporting history by converting a field goal at 3,454 meters atop Switzerland's Jungfraujoch, setting a Guinness World Record for the highest successful field goal ever attempted.
